newsitem.title: CHINA: China army plant reorganises as limited company.
newsitem.headline: China army plant reorganises as limited company.

text.p: China's People's Liberation Army has reorganised one of its printing plants as a limited shareholding company, the Economic Daily said on Tuesday.
The Number 2207 factory was renamed the Beijing Lingqi Printing Co Ltd, the newspaper said.
The company, which is still considered state-owned, has assets of several hundred million yuan, it said without giving further details.
The factory prints more than 50 periodicals and comics, it added.
